records.notes: The visible lexical form is consistent; Warsh shows اٰيَٰتِيَ while the other editions show ءَايَٰتِيَ, an initial alif/hamza presentation difference.
Visible forms differ between ٱلنَّبِيَّ, اَ۬لنَّبِيَّ, and Warsh/Qalun اَ۬لنَّبِےٓءَ; the latter includes a clear final hamza/letter-form difference.
Visible forms differ between ٱلنَّبِيِّ, ا۬لنَّبِيِّ, and Warsh/Qalun اِ۬لنَّبِےٓءِ; the latter includes a clear final hamza/letter-form difference.
Visible forms show نَّغۡفِرۡ in most editions and تُغۡفَرۡ in Warsh/Qalun, a clear active/passive and consonantal difference.
Visible forms show خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِكُمۡ or its pronoun-marked form in most editions, خَطِيٓـَٰٔتُكُمۡ in Warsh/Qalun, and خَطَٰيَىٰكُمۡ in Duri/Susi, with clear stem/vowel and ending differences.
